cases.name: Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.
UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, MA, that operates an AI music generation platform at suno.com. The company describes its product as capable of producing complete original songs, including vocals, lyrics, and full production, from a single text prompt in under a minute, across any genre. It offers a free tier as well as paid plans: a Pro plan providing 500 songs per month, royalty-free music, commercial use rights, stem separation, and access to what the site calls its v5.5 model, and a Premier plan providing 2,000 songs per month along with Suno Studio, a web-based generative audio workstation that the company describes as combining traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered creation, including a multitrack editor, MIDI export, and persona voices.

Suno faces substantial litigation. The most prominent case is UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc., filed in the District of Massachusetts, which involves major record labels. Additional suits have been filed in the Southern District of Texas, the District of Massachusetts, the Southern District of New York, and the Northern District of Illinois, brought by a range of individual plaintiffs as well as entities including S.A. Jamendo and Poseidon Wave Media LLC. In total, held facts record 88 legal exposure entries associated with Massachusetts, reflecting the concentration of cases in that jurisdiction.
